name: Rewrite an email to be more professional
problem: Turning informal or unprofessional email content into a more formal and appropriate tone.
when_to_use: Use when you have an informal or unprofessional email and want to make it more formal and appropriate.
use_cases: turn informal email into formal email
instructions: Rewrite the email content to be more formal and appropriate, ensuring it is suitable for professional communication.

example.input: Hey, I wanted to follow up on our meeting yesterday. We need to get this project done by next week.
example.output: Good morning [Name], I wanted to follow up on our meeting yesterday. We need to ensure this project is completed by next week.
